findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: calculate_japan_airlines_miles, calculate_aerolineas_argentinas_miles, calculate_etihad_guest_miles · Public sink: calculate_air_india_points, calculate_malaysia_airlines_enrich_points, calculate_aegean_airlines_miles, calculate_srilankan_airlines_miles, calculate_etihad_guest_miles.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: calculate_japan_airlines_miles, calculate_aerolineas_argentinas_miles, calculate_etihad_guest_miles · Public sink: calculate_air_india_points, calculate_malaysia_airlines_enrich_points, calculate_aegean_airlines_miles, calculate_srilankan_airlines_miles, calculate_etihad_guest_miles

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
